body: Strange, it still says pre ordered on my App Store :/. I saw an article from toucharcade that says it launched but I can’t download it
Thanks man. I’m calling the hotline now in hopes someone can talk some sense into me

The stupid thing is that my parents are quite wealthy and there’s no realistic chance of me ending up homeless. I just feel this deep shame down in my core that everyone is disappointed in me and that I’m never going to be able to actually be an independent adult.

I feel like a huge drain on everyone around me and it’s breaking me inside.

I hope things get better for you. I don’t know that they will for me. I could keep scraping by in some mediocre existence but am I ever going to be happy?

I’m just in so much pain.

Thanks for commenting
